_comment: The plan-cap half of registration, against the CLERK-mode pair. Under AUTH_PROVIDER=local — which the default tiers run — `resolve_org_plan` returns "self_host" before reading anything, its cap is 999, and nothing is ever skipped. All four of these mutations survived a full run of the register spec for that reason, with the cases that cover them passing. Splitting them out is not tidiness: the mutator restarts one pair per spec, and a spec spanning both would score half its mutations against an unmutated binary.

mutations.name: the plan-limit notice is not debounced
the skipped list is not capped at five
mutations._why: The body names the first five and counts the rest. Listing all of them turns a notification into a wall of camera names.

mutations.name: cameras over the cap are created anyway
the running count ignores what this request created
mutations._why: Without `new_camera_count` the cap is compared against the count taken before the loop, so a single register can create as many cameras as it reports — the cap holds against one camera at a time and not against a batch.
